Flutter app: ci.yml runs flutter analyze/test and flutter build apk/appbundle --release (Gradle only inside Flutter's build; no Lint task); fdroid-watch.yml runs scripts/fdroid-mr-watch.sh (no Gradle). Release assemble may run lintVital (fatal-only), which the pre-registration excludes

.github/workflows/android.yml (push/pull_request master) runs ./gradlew build; build depends on check, and the Android Gradle Plugin makes check depend on lint, so Lint runs. The detector records this as ci_implicit (not ci_lint), as pre-registered, so its ci_lint call is wrong here
release.yml runs python3 tools/release_apks.py (attaches F-Droid-built APKs; no Gradle); website.yml builds a Hugo site and deploys with rsync (no Gradle)

build.yml runs ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest, assembleRelease (tags), assembleDev (dev branch), assembleDebug (PRs); no lint/check/build task. assembleRelease may run lintVital (fatal-only), excluded by the pre-registration

build.yml calls buildscripts/include/ci.sh build -> ./buildall.sh -n -> buildscripts/scripts/mpv-android.sh, which runs ./gradlew assembleDebug [assembleRelease] and bundleRelease; no Lint task (traced through all three scripts)

.gitlab-ci.yml runs ktlintCheck (Kotlin style, not Android Lint), unit tests, bundle/minify/assemble tasks and fastlane lanes; fastlane/Fastfile gradle() calls use test, assemble* and bundle* only. An included strix-scan.yml template (another project) was not readable; its jobs are security scans
